name: Pinky
tagline: Apache-2.0 desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP agent operate a real iPhone or Android phone while you watch, with a gateway that blocks finance apps and holds payments or other risky taps until you approve, plus a replay of every step

xSignals.text: 给本地 Agent 放权操控真机，大家最怕的从来不是它点错，而是冷不丁在后台把钱给付了。DIYgod 刚开源了一个叫 Pinky 的工具，专门解决把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这类 Agent 接入真实手机的问题。Mac、Windows、Linux 都能跑，开源免费。
